sources.excerpt:
Schema: aviation
Table: flights
Qualified name: aviation.flights
Description: Scheduled flight instances with origin, destination, timings, and assigned aircraft.
Columns:
- flight_id: VARCHAR(20); PRIMARY KEY, NOT NULL, MAX LENGTH 20; Unique scheduled flight instance.
- flight_number: VARCHAR(10); NOT NULL, MAX LENGTH 10; Commercial flight number.
- departure_airport_id: INTEGER; NOT NULL; Origin airport identifier.
- arrival_airport_id: INTEGER; NOT NULL; Destination airport identifier.
- aircraft_id: INTEGER; NULLABLE; Assigned aircraft identifier.
- scheduled_departure: TIMESTAMP; NOT NULL; Planned departure timestamp.
- scheduled_arrival: TIMESTAMP; NOT NULL; Planned arrival timestamp.
Relationships:
- aviation.flights.departure_airport_id -> aviation.airports.airport_id; Many flights depart from one airport.
- aviation.flights.arrival_airport_id -> aviation.airports.airport_id; Many flights arrive at one airport.
- aviation.flights.aircraft_id -> aviation.aircraft.aircraft_id; An aircraft can operate many flight instances.
Tags: flight, schedule, departure, arrival, aircraft

Schema: aviation
Table: aircraft
Qualified name: aviation.aircraft
Description: Master data for aircraft available for flight operations.
Columns:
- aircraft_id: INTEGER; PRIMARY KEY, NOT NULL; Surrogate aircraft identifier.
- registration_number: VARCHAR(20); NOT NULL, MAX LENGTH 20; Synthetic aircraft registration.
- aircraft_type: VARCHAR(50); NOT NULL, MAX LENGTH 50; Aircraft model such as A350-900.
- seat_capacity: INTEGER; NOT NULL; Configured passenger seat capacity.
- active_flag: BOOLEAN; NOT NULL; Whether the aircraft is active.
Relationships:
- No outbound foreign keys
Tags: aircraft, fleet, registration, capacity

Schema: aviation
Table: airports
Qualified name: aviation.airports
Description: Reference data for airports served by the synthetic airline network.
Columns:
- airport_id: INTEGER; PRIMARY KEY, NOT NULL; Surrogate airport identifier.
- iata_code: VARCHAR(3); NOT NULL, MAX LENGTH 3; Three-letter IATA airport code.
- airport_name: VARCHAR(150); NOT NULL, MAX LENGTH 150; Airport display name.
- city: VARCHAR(100); NOT NULL, MAX LENGTH 100; City served by the airport.
- country_code: CHAR(2); NOT NULL, MAX LENGTH 2; ISO-style country code.
- timezone: VARCHAR(50); NOT NULL, MAX LENGTH 50; Airport time zone.
Relationships:
- No outbound foreign keys
Tags: airport, reference, location, iata
